title: Transactional Atomic Savepoint Stacks & Multi-Database Router Isolation

claims.assertion: Nested transactional units must use savepoint stacks to support fine-grained rollback without aborting outer transaction blocks, integrated with database router hints for write safety

context: In complex agent workflows, nested tool calls, or multi-tenant database operations, a failure in a subordinate task shouldn't necessarily fail the entire outer batch if the child error can be caught and handled.
